description: Learn basic stitching, garment making and sewing techniques for employment or home-based work.
Learn decorative stitching techniques to create attractive designs on clothes and fabrics.
Learn to create useful and decorative handmade products using simple craft techniques and materials.
Learn to make cloth, jute and reusable bags that can be sold as handmade products.
Learn how to make decorative and scented candles for a small home-based business.
Learn basic handmade soap-making methods and safe handling of materials.
Learn to create handmade jewellery using beads, threads, wires and other materials.
Develop painting skills using different techniques and materials for creative work.
Learn basic clay modelling and pottery techniques to create useful and decorative products.
Learn flower arrangement and decoration techniques for events and small businesses.
Learn to create personalised gift items, hampers and decorative products for customers.
Learn basic makeup techniques, product use and professional makeup practices.
Learn basic hairstyling, hair care and techniques useful for home-based or local beauty services.
Learn creative nail decoration techniques that can be offered as a beauty service.
Learn basic skincare practices, hygiene and professional skin-care techniques.
Learn baking techniques for cakes, breads, cookies and other products for home businesses.
Improve cooking skills and learn techniques for preparing different dishes professionally.
Learn methods of preparing, preserving and packaging food products for small-scale businesses.
Learn natural farming methods, soil care and sustainable techniques for growing crops.
Learn basic dairy management, animal care, feeding and hygienic milk production.
Learn basic poultry management, feeding, hygiene and small-scale farming practices.
Develop teaching and tutoring skills to support children and learners in academic subjects.
Learn basic childcare, child safety, hygiene and age-appropriate activities.
Learn basic caregiving, communication, safety and daily assistance for elderly people.
Learn basic bookkeeping, recording transactions, billing and managing business accounts.
Understand saving, budgeting, banking, digital payments, loans and responsible money management.
Improve speaking, listening, confidence and communication for personal and professional situations.
Build confidence and learn how to present ideas clearly in front of others.
Learn how to prepare for interviews, answer common questions and present yourself professionally.
Improve everyday English vocabulary, grammar and spoken English for workplace and daily communication.
Learn how to plan a small home-based business, identify needs, estimate costs and organize the steps to start.
Understand the basic steps involved in turning a small business idea into a practical home-based venture.
Learn how to understand customers, identify local demand and study similar businesses before starting.
Learn how to calculate product costs, set suitable prices and understand basic profit and expenses.
Learn the basic requirements and steps involved in registering a small business.
